description: This HTML file defines the user interface for a Database Visualizer web application, including layout styling, sidebar for database selection, table display area, and embedded JavaScript for dynamic data fetching and UI interactions.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches the list of available databases and populates the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the database list by re-fetching data from the server.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Toggles the display of tables within a selected database.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches tables belonging to a database and displays them in the sidebar.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Loads and renders data for a selected table.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Generates HTML for the data table, including headers and rows.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Renders individual cell content, handling objects and long strings with expansion feature.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses cell content to show full data for long strings or objects.

search-terms: pages for database and table selection
